rotowire.headline: James finished with 15 points (6-13 FG, 0-2 3Pt, 3-5 FT), seven rebounds, nine assists and a steal across 31 minutes in Monday's 126-107 win over the Bulls.
rotowire.story: James has yet to score more than 20 points in a game this season, but he's still adding value elsewhere. He finished just one assist shy of a double-double while grabbing seven rebounds. James' relatively modest scoring output reflected Philadelphia's balanced offensive approach, although his playmaking and rebounding continue to provide a dependable fantasy foundation. Through six games, James is averaging 16.2 points, 7.0 rebounds and 7.3 assists per game.
rotowire.description: James finished with 15 points (6-13 FG, 0-2 3Pt, 3-5 FT), seven rebounds, nine assists and a steal across 31 minutes in Monday's 126-107 win over the Bulls.

fantasy.projection: James willingly accepted a third option role with the Lakers last season, allowing Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves to operate at higher usage. After signing with the 76ers this offseason, James finds himself in a similar situation where he will likely be the third or fourth option behind teammates Tyrese Maxey, Jaylen Brown and Joel Embiid. James may play some point forward, so his assists may increase, but his scoring volume and overall fantasy production are likely capped.
